geometry_notes: Right half: soffit chamfer 3/4 in (callout '3/4 in bottom chamfer (Typ)'); bottom flange edge height 6 3/4 (Tx28-40) or 8 3/4 (Tx46-70); 1:2 taper 9 1/2 run x 4 3/4 rise; 3x3 in web fillet; 7 in web; 2x2 in top fillet; top taper 12 1/2 (15 1/2 for Tx62/70) run with 2 (2 1/2) in rise; 3 1/2 in flange edge.
Clear web B = D - (3.5 + taper rise + 2 + 3 + 4.75 + edge height) reproduces the printed B column for all sizes.
Top-flange edges are square on the drawing; 6 in bar R projection and optional 3/4 in vertical end chamfer are not part of the section.
Same bottom flange/web template as IGD; 72 in (WF-Tx28-54) or 84 in (WF-Tx62/70) top flange; taper rise 4 7/8 (5 7/8) over 30 1/2 (36 1/2) run; 3 1/2 in edge.
Exterior-girder curb (6 in x 1'-0") and 3/4 in drip bead are omitted: they are 'outer side of exterior girders only' (note 14) and the printed properties exclude them (exact match).
WF-Tx62 printed Ix 660,613 in^4 disagrees with the outline by exactly 20,000 in^4 while A, Yb, Iy and weight match; treated as a digit misprint of 680,613 and pinned.

geometry_notes: Figure 11 (PSTRS14): C top width, D depth, E soffit-to-flange-underside at web, F clear top opening, G inner kink half-width, H kink height above bottom slab, J/K outer offsets.
Outer web face from bottom corner (27.5, 0) to (27.5+J, E): slope J/E = 1:3.97 for both types. Flange outer edge: 3/8 in batter over 5 7/8 in; flange soffit falls 7/8 in to the web.
Inner web face: (F/2, D) -> (G, 8 1/4 + H) -> (25 1/4, 11 1/4) -> chamfer to (21 1/2, 8 1/4). The 1 3/4 in = F/2 - G run and 2'-1 1/4 / 1'-9 1/2 callouts are read from the figure.
Residuals vs printed: U40 area +2.8 in^2 (+0.28%), yb -0.01 in, I +0.23%; U54 area +1.7 in^2 (+0.15%), yb -0.02 in, I +0.23%. Likely small undimensioned corner rounding; not fitted away.

Fitted per depth family (common to 6/7/8 widths) by least squares to the 9 printed A/Yb/I values: DS20 void 35.480 x 6.608 in at 6.224 in above soffit, deck-edge undercut 2.194 in; DS23 void 44.321 x 8.432 in at 6.696 in, undercut 2.693 in.
